name: maze_frame
note: MAZE's own per-frame routine (main calls it in game_state 0 and the other non-camp maze states). Marks the automap bit for the square (and the floor above, except on listed areas), runs any event-box countdown, then dispatches on game_state: 0 walking (maze_walk), 4 0x800b2e8c, 6 0x800b4388, 7 0x800a3824, 8 0x800ae1c8, 0xa/0xb MAIN 0x8001a628/0x8001a848, 0xd, 0xe, 0xf, 0x10, 0x11 pick a member (0x800ac798), 0x12; then maze_prompt_result when a yes/no answer is pending.

name: maze_walk
note: Walking (game_state 0): turns and steps with their animation; when a step lands it runs roamer_meet, maze_step (unless DAT_800798e0 is 1 or 2), wipe_check and square_arrive; moves the roamers (roamer_move, then roamer_meet again) when 0x80079bf0 is set.

name: roamer_meet
note: After a step: if a roamer token stands on the party's square, start the meeting. Token type (0x8005de20) 0 or 2 starts a fight (encounter id 0xffff or 0xfffe, encounter_pick unless 0x80079b2e bit 0), 1 or 3 starts a talk with talk_party = roamer_party[slot]; prints SISETU 0x1d8 'You've met someone!'. Returns 1 fight, 2 talk, 0 nothing.

name: roamers_place
note: On entering a floor: npc_availability, then up to npc_tokens_per_area[area] NPC party tokens on random roamer slots (random party 0-4 that is in npc_available and not npc_fixed_pending), type2_tokens_per_area[area] type-2 tokens, the pending fixed meetings at their squares (fixed_meet_table), clears any token on the party's square, and disarms a fight-type square event under the party.

name: npc_availability
note: Per area group: which NPC parties may be met at random (npc_available, bits 0-4 = parties 0-4) and which fixed meetings are still pending (npc_fixed_list), from npc_flags bits. Details in docs/re/A-maze.md.

name: roamers_reset
note: Copies each roamer slot's start square from roamer_slots into roamer_x/roamer_y, clears their headings, calls 0x800c45dc, removes any on the party's square and rolls 0x80079b1c = rand_upto(11).

name: roamer_move
note: Moves every roamer token except type 3 (fixed meetings) one square: picks at random among the open directions (no wall, not off the map, no token there, not onto stairs, lifts, teleports, pits or other blocked event types, not onto an unspent fight square), not reversing unless stuck. Plays sound 0xb or 0xf when one comes within a square of the party.

name: wipe_check
note: Sets maze_wiped (0x80079a12) when every member has status & 0x1e0 (paralyzed, stoned, dead or ash). main then loads BATTLE and runs party_wiped.

name: square_arrive
note: Runs the event record of the square the party just stepped onto (square_event_index -> event_records): 1 teleport, 6 chute, 8 ladder, 0xc, 0x13, 0x14 fight square, 0x15, 0x17 lift, 0x19, 0x1a, 0x2b, 0x3b, 0x41 circle, 0x44/0x45 one-way turns, 0x4a, 0x4c, 0x61, 0x64, 0x65, 0x67-0x69, 0x6f.

name: square_examine
note: Investigate (START menu, 0x800cc5e0; 0x800ac500 plays the search animation and loads EVENTMES first): runs the square's event record against what the party faces: signs and murals (0x20 etc.), the four pillars on the Grounds (0xe-0x11, talk_party 0-3, stone items 0x136-0x139, Tablet 0x143), locked and sealed doors, altars and machines. Most cases check cur_facing against the record.

name: maze_prompt_result
note: Outcome of an event's yes/no prompt: maze_prompt_pending (0x80079907) picks the event (1-0x20), maze_prompt_answer (0x8007e800) 0 = yes. Prints the yes or no EVENTMES string and starts the scene (fight, item, flag).

name: event_show
note: Opens the event box and prints EVENTMES string N (MAIN 0x8001fb4c(6, N, 1)); remembers N at 0x8007981e.

name: party_lacks_item
note: Returns 0 if any member carries item id N (low 9 bits) with bit 0x4000 set, else -1.

name: flag_test
note: Bit N of the 32-bit word at the pointer (bank, N). Lives in MAZE, so MAIN's callers run with MAZE resident.

name: flag_clear
note: Clears bit N of the word at the pointer.

name: meet_start
note: Starts the approach animation for a meeting: kind 0 fight, 1, 3 talk (0x80079795), 0x11 frames. meet_animate ends it.

name: meet_animate
note: The approach animation (fog and light fade). At the end: kind 3 queues game_mode 9 (talk); kind 0 queues game_mode 2 (battle), stores cur_area in the party's map field and picks the group (encounter_pick).

name: mode_switch_after_music
note: When the jingle ends (SsIsEos), applies the queued game_state and game_mode; for a battle, picks the battle music by encounter id.

name: encounter_pick
note: Picks the enemy group for a maze fight from the map type's tables (map_type_of_area): 0xffff with encounter_source 2 (fight square) rolls a tier (odds 0x80059df0) and picks in it; 0xffff from a wandering token picks from wander_groups; 0xfffe picks from type2_groups (+0x154); source 4 = id + 0x17b (NPC party), 5 = id + 0x154; otherwise the id is fixed. Then loads the group file (table 1, id + 0x2c).

name: party_store_pos
note: For each member: area = cur_area if the member's roster index is 0, else 0xff (sic: the test is on the index, at 0x8001bbf8), then x, y, facing. Called on entering the maze and every frame of the camp; camp_main writes cur_area for every member right after, so the odd branch has no lasting effect there.

name: roamer_x
note: x of each of the 16 roamer tokens on this floor (0xff = gone).

name: roamer_y
note: y of each roamer token.

name: roamer_heading
note: Last direction each token moved (0 north... 3 west); roamer_move avoids reversing it.

name: roamer_slots
note: 16 slots of 3 bytes: token type (0 wandering monsters, 1 NPC party, 2 type-2 group, 3 fixed meeting), start x, start y, from the floor's map data.

name: roamer_party
note: For an NPC token (type 1 or 3): the talk_party it starts.

name: npc_available
note: Bits 0-4: NPC parties 0-4 (Guy, Balbo, Fontana, 3, 4) that may be placed on this floor (npc_availability).

name: npc_fixed_pending
note: Bits 0-4: parties whose fixed meeting on this area group hasn't happened; they aren't placed at random. On areas below 5, any pending fixed meeting stops all random NPC tokens.

name: npc_fixed_count
note: Number of fixed meetings in npc_fixed_list.

name: npc_fixed_list
note: talk_party ids (6 and up) of the fixed meetings to place on this floor.

name: npc_tokens_per_area
note: Two bytes per area: NPC party tokens to place (1 on most areas, 0 in the Training Maze, Dragon's Cave and Area Z), then type-2 tokens.

name: fixed_meet_table
note: For talk_party 6 to 0x19, 3 bytes: area, x, y of the fixed meeting.

name: npc_flags
note: Story bits mostly written by the talk handlers; npc_availability tests bits 2, 4, 5, 7, 8, 0xa-0x12, 0x14, 0x15, 0x18. Bit 0x12 clear = Balbo's first meeting (Shrine 3F) still to come, 0x14 = Fontana's (Shrine 4F), and so on (A-maze.md).

name: fight_squares_spent
note: Bit p4 of each fight square (event 0x14) on this floor: set the first time the party steps on it, whether or not the fight happened. Cleared on entering a floor (0x800a42c8, 0x800a4498).

name: square_event_index
note: Event record index of the party's current square (from the map's per-square byte at 0x8005d4d0).

name: square_event_map
note: 24 x 24 bytes: the event record index for each square of the current floor (0 = none).

name: event_records
note: The current floor's event records, 5 bytes: type, p1, p2, p3, p4. Map file offset 0x3340 (the floor's map data from file offset 0x400 is mirrored at 0x8005ac50).

name: square_flags
note: 24 x 24 u32 flag words for the current floor: bit 31 starts the no-magic countdown, bit 0 keeps the floor above off the automap, 0x100-0x800 one per side (roamer_move's barriers).

name: automap_seen
note: Visited squares: 3 bytes a row, 24 rows, 0x48 bytes per area.

name: map_type_of_area
note: Map type per area (indexes the encounter tables; 30-37 are the Training Maze's eight floors, which party_wiped checks to send a wiped party to town).

name: wander_groups
note: 9 u16 group ids per map type for wandering tokens; count per type at 0x8005a504.

name: zone_groups_tier0
note: Fight squares: 9 u16 group ids per map type (tier 0); tier 1 at 0x8005a1b8 (4 per type), tier 2 at 0x8005a308 (2 per type); counts 0x80059e44 (3 per type); tier odds 0x80059df0 (2 per type: 65/25 on most, 57/29 in the Training Maze).

name: type2_groups
note: 7 bytes per map type: groups for type-2 tokens, plus 0x154 (ids 340 up); count per type at 0x8005a3b0.

name: encounter_id
note: The group to fight: 0xffff random by map type, 0xfffe type-2 token, else a fixed id.

name: encounter_source
note: How encounter_pick reads encounter_id: 0 wandering token, 2 fight square, 4 NPC party (+0x17b), 5 (+0x154).

name: maze_wiped
note: 1 when wipe_check finds nobody able (main loads BATTLE and calls party_wiped); 2 is used by maze_walk too.

name: maze_prompt_pending
note: Which event's yes/no outcome maze_prompt_result runs (0 none).

name: maze_prompt_answer
note: The yes/no answer for maze_prompt_result: 0 yes.

name: meet_kind
note: meet_start's kind: 0 fight, 3 talk.

name: queued_game_mode
note: Game mode applied by mode_switch_after_music (9 talk or 2 battle).

name: party_area
note: The current party's area (party record +0x34), written with cur_area on floor changes; party_wiped and encounter_pick read the map type through it.

name: maze_event_flags
note: Maze progress bits: 0x4000, 0x8000, 0x10000, 0x20000 = the four Grounds pillars done (square_examine cases 0xe-0x11); many more written by the event code.

name: square_walls
note: 24 x 24 wall-pattern indexes for the current floor (map file offset 0x400), into the wall table at 0x8005de54 (low nibble walls, high nibble doors).
